AUTH0_DOMAIN.description: Your tenant's domain, such as example.us.auth0.com.

AUTH0_CLIENT_ID.description: Auth0 states the client id is public information.

AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Auth0 says this must be kept confidential. Rotating it accepts either value for up to thirty seconds.

AUTH0_SECRET.description: Encrypts the session cookie, not an Auth0 credential. Thirty-two bytes hex, from openssl rand -hex 32.
